- Option A: Thu Jul 6, 1:00–2:30 PM PT (best for east-coast stakeholders)
- Option B: Fri Jul 7, 9:00–10:30 AM PT (better for your infra/ops folks)

Agenda (attached):
- 10 min introductions & objectives
- 25 min Console: model catalog, routing, and rollback
- 30 min API: token provisioning, sample calls, error handling
- 20 min Hands-on lab: runbook-based exercise + Q/A

Prereqs: one engineer with permission to create service accounts (we'll ask for a short-lived API key during the lab). I attached the agenda and a short preflight checklist.

If neither slot works, please tell us a range that does (morning/afternoon PT) and who will join from your side (dev, infra, PM). I can also send a Doodle if that helps.

Thanks — Kim
